fishing: Fall-winter bite full swing. WHEN: Trout firing on deeper mangrove banks (freeline shrimp); redfish/snook on oyster beds & mangroves in Lemon Bay. PASSES-BEACH: Stump/Boca Grande – small sheepshead, whiting, jacks, Spanish mackerel, snook; beach trout, whiting, pompano. LEMON BAY: Bigger redfish, snook. NEARSHORE: Sheepshead starting on reefs; tarpon thinning. Baits: live shrimp, whitebait/pilchards, cutbait.
redtide: FWC 11/24: K. brevis bloom concentrations in NW FL (Bay/Gulf counties) with fish kills there; very low/none reported in SWFL Charlotte/Sarasota.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach Good (10 enterococci/100mL on 11/16); Englewood Beach Good.
